title: A server script that needs a tool that's gone
prompt: On {{ssh}}, ~/app/build-report.sh is supposed to write ~/app/out/summary.json, but it fails. Fix the script on the server so it works (it runs every night on new data, so the script itself has to work), and run it once.
notes: Recovery: the script needs csvsum, which was uninstalled (and nothing can be installed), and after that the out/ folder doesn't exist. The agent has to reimplement the step from the script's own description. The checker runs the fixed script on new data, so writing summary.json by hand fails.
